'''Kowakian Monkey Island''' was a [[Painting/Legends|poster]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Missing" />

==Behind the scenes==
This poster was painted by [[Amy Beth Christenson]], and was developed for [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']] episode "[[Missing in Action]]." It is one of several posters based on classic [[LucasArts]] [[Wikipedia:Adventure game|adventure games]], but done with a ''Star Wars'' twist. The title is a reference to the [[Wikipedia:Monkey Island (series)|''Monkey Island'']] adventure games, and the motif is based on the cover art for the fourth game in the series, [[Wikipedia:Escape from Monkey Island|''Escape from Monkey Island'']].<ref name="SW">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/missing-in-action-trivia-gallery|text="Missing in Action" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 11}}</ref>
